texto: Summarize the attached file in short bullet points, highlighting names, places, conflicts and hooks.
Check whether the attached file contradicts anything already established in the world. For each contradiction, say what is wrong, which file holds the official version and how to fix it.
Suggest 10 names for [what: people, places, taverns...], consistent with the cultures and the sound of the world, with a one-line explanation for each.
Create 5 adventure hooks tied to [place or NPC], using conflicts that already exist in the world.
Suggest 3 encounters for a level [level] party in [place], with enemies, terrain, goal and a complication.
Create an NPC for [place or role]: name, appearance, motivation, a secret and a memorable line.
Create 6 rumors about [subject] the players might hear in a tavern: 3 true, 2 partly true and 1 false (mark which is which for the GM only).
Describe the attached image as read-aloud text for the players and suggest how it could fit into the world.
Point out the most important gaps in the project: concepts mentioned without a file, unanswered questions and loose ends. Order them by what helps the next session the most.
